name: Aspirational luxury couple (150,000+)

sources: Zoho CRM Consumers sample, 712 unique records, 516 genuine couples, analysed 2026-10-28
evidence.supporting_records: about 11 plausible 150,000+ destination records, none won, most uncontacted
evidence.notes: The CRM does NOT support this as a proven ICP. It represents the brand's target positioning. Weight its feedback lower and never let it override evidence-based personas.

context: Time-poor, used to concierge-level service. Will not read long pages. Wants proof and a senior contact quickly.
jobs_to_be_done: Hand the whole thing to one trusted team
Give guests an unforgettable multi-day experience
emotional_drivers: Guest experience (a quiz respondent listed 'guests' as what keeps them up at night)
top_questions: Can we take the whole property exclusively?
Who is the senior planner and how fast can we speak?
What guest experiences can you create beyond the wedding day?
Who else have you done this for?

objections.objection: Feels like a mass-market package page
From prices signal a lower tier than we expect

verbatims: safari, helicopter (what would make them gasp)
decision_role: Couple, sometimes with a family office or parents (assumption)
reading_behaviour: 30-second skim on a phone between meetings
conversion_threshold: Will enquire only if the page feels exclusive and gives a fast route to a senior person
assumptions: Almost every trait in this file
